# opencode-selfhost

> Self-hosted OpenCode server in Docker behind a Caddy reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS.

Website: https://www.danifernandezs.com/opencode-selfhost/
Repository: https://github.com/danifernandezs/opencode-selfhost

## What it does

Runs [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) as a remote server inside Docker, behind a Caddy reverse proxy that provides automatic TLS via Let's Encrypt. Only the API endpoints required by `opencode attach` are exposed — the web UI and all other endpoints are blocked.

## Architecture

- **OpenCode** (port 4096, localhost only) — holds sessions, projects, tools, and the LLM config
- **Caddy** (ports 80/443) — terminates TLS, whitelists API endpoints, proxies to OpenCode
- **Watchtower** — auto-updates the Docker image every hour

## Key files

- `Dockerfile` — based on the official OpenCode image, adds git, jq, curl. Runs as root so the agent can install packages at runtime
- `compose.yaml` — orchestrates OpenCode + Caddy + Watchtower with volumes for data persistence
- `Caddyfile` — reverse proxy config with API endpoint whitelist and 600s timeouts
- `.env.example` — template for DOMAIN and OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD
- `opencode.json.example` — template for LLM provider configuration (OpenAI-compatible)

## Usage

Connect from any machine with OpenCode installed:

```bash
opencode attach https://oc.yourdomain.com \
  --password your-server-password \
  --dir /projects/my-project
```
